text: I'm so sorry to bother you at this hour. My granddaughter is 7 and is staying with me. Her temperature is 39.4. Her breathing is very fast, and I can see the skin pulling in under her ribs with each breath, which I don't like the look of at all. She hasn't had any fit or shaking, nothing like that. I didn't want to waste anyone's time but I'm worried. Apologies again.
